    ms ⊢ |==> msgOwn l DFrac.discard ms

    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe cap ms ⊢ ∃ p, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
    go!"To" l) p (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ∀ p' v, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"To" l) p'
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ cellRO p' v -∗ msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe cap { msg :=
                    have __src := ms.msg;
                    { Type' := __src.Type', To' := v, From' := __src.From', Term' := __src.Term',
                      LogTerm' := __src.LogTerm', Index' := __src.Index', Commit' := __src.Commit',
                      Vote' := __src.Vote', Reject' := __src.Reject', RejectHint' := __src.RejectHint' },
                  ents := ms.ents, snap := ms.snap, ctx := ms.ctx, resps := ms.resps }

theorem entsPts_elim [package_sem : Assumptions] (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) :
    entsPts s dq es ⊢ ∃ ls, ownSlice s ls dq ∗ [∗list] l;e ∈ ls;es, entRO l e

theorem msgPtsC_to_msgOwn [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms :
    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms ⊢ |==> msgOwn l dq ms

theorem msgPtsC_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (v : raftpb.Message) (dqe : DFrac)
    (cap : Bool) (els : List Loc) (ms : MsgSt) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) :
    typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ cellRO v.Type' ms.msg.Type' ∗ cellRO v.To' ms.msg.To' ∗ cellRO
    v.From' ms.msg.From' ∗ cellRO v.Term' ms.msg.Term' ∗ cellRO v.LogTerm' ms.msg.LogTerm' ∗ cellRO
    v.Index' ms.msg.Index' ∗ cellRO v.Commit' ms.msg.Commit' ∗ cellRO v.Vote' ms.msg.Vote' ∗ cellRO
    v.Reject' ms.msg.Reject' ∗ cellRO v.RejectHint' ms.msg.RejectHint' ∗ ownSlice v.Entries' els dqe
    ∗ ([∗list] p;e ∈ els;ms.ents, entRO p e) ∗ (if cap = true then ownSliceCap Loc v.Entries'
    (DFrac.own 1) else emp) ∗ snapOpt v.Snapshot' (DFrac.own 1) ms.snap ∗ ownSlice v.Context' ms.ctx
    DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice v.Responses' ms.resps (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |={E}=> msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1)
    dqe cap ms

theorem snapOpt_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (o : Option SnapshotM) :
    snapOpt p dq o ⊢ |==> snapOpt p DFrac.discard o

theorem snapOpt_persistent (p : Loc) (o : Option SnapshotM) : Persistent (snapOpt p DFrac.discard o)

theorem msgPtsC_cap_any [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms :
    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l dq dqe true ms ⊢ msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms

theorem msgIn_of_msgPtsC_cap [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dqe : DFrac) (ms : MsgSt) :
    msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe true ms ⊢ msgIn l dqe ms

theorem msgOwn_to_msgIn [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (ms : MsgSt) (h : ms.msg.Type' ≠
    MsgApp) : msgOwn l (DFrac.own 1) ms ⊢ msgIn l DFrac.discard ms

theorem msgPtsC_persist_els [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms
    : MsgSt) : msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms ⊢ |==> msgPtsC l dq DFrac.discard cap ms

theorem msgPtsC_drop_cap [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms :
    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms ⊢ msgPts l dq dqe ms

theorem msgPtsC_fields_acc [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (dq dqe : DFrac) (cap : Bool) (ms :
    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms ⊢ ∃ es cs, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
    go!"Entries" l) es dq ∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Context" l) cs dq ∗
    ⌜(es = slice.nil → ms.ents = []) ∧ (cs = slice.nil → ms.ctx = [])⌝ ∗ (typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Entries" l) es dq -∗ typedPointsto (structFieldRef
    raftpb.Message go!"Context" l) cs dq -∗ msgPtsC l dq dqe cap ms)

    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe cap ms ⊢ |==> msgOwn l (DFrac.own 1) ms

    MsgSt) : msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe cap ms ⊢ ∃ p, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message
    go!"Term" l) p (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ∀ p' v, typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Message go!"Term" l)
    p' (DFrac.own 1) -∗ cellRO p' v -∗ msgPtsC l (DFrac.own 1) dqe cap { msg :=
                    have __src := ms.msg;
                    { Type' := __src.Type', To' := __src.To', From' := __src.From', Term' := v,

                      Vote' := __src.Vote', Reject' := __src.Reject', RejectHint' := __src.RejectHint' },
                  ents := ms.ents, snap := ms.snap, ctx := ms.ctx, resps := ms.resps }

theorem msgOwn_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (v : raftpb.Message) (els : List Loc)
    (ms : MsgSt) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1)
    ∗ cellRO v.Type' ms.msg.Type' ∗ cellRO v.To' ms.msg.To' ∗ cellRO v.From' ms.msg.From' ∗ cellRO
    v.Term' ms.msg.Term' ∗ cellRO v.LogTerm' ms.msg.LogTerm' ∗ cellRO v.Index' ms.msg.Index' ∗
    cellRO v.Commit' ms.msg.Commit' ∗ cellRO v.Vote' ms.msg.Vote' ∗ cellRO v.Reject' ms.msg.Reject'
    ∗ cellRO v.RejectHint' ms.msg.RejectHint' ∗ ownSlice v.Entries' els DFrac.discard ∗ ([∗list] p;e
    ∈ els;ms.ents, entRO p e) ∗ snapOpt v.Snapshot' (DFrac.own 1) ms.snap ∗ ownSlice v.Context'
    ms.ctx DFrac.discard ∗ ownSlice v.Responses' ms.resps (DFrac.own 1) ⊢ |={E}=> msgOwn l
    (DFrac.own 1) ms
